Name: MniCal's Handsome Obelisks
Author: MniCal
Description:
MniCal's Handsome Obelisks
Handsome obelisk retextures ＆ a flavour message every time you teleport.
This mod replaces the four vanilla obelisk sprites with custom artwork, and shows a short random message in the bottom-left corner whenever you teleport with an obelisk. Everything can be toggled in-game.

Installation
Install SMAPI.
(Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want the in-game settings menu.
Unzip the download and move the `MniCal's Handsome Obelisks` folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder. `manifest.json` must sit directly inside that folder.
Launch the game.

Permissions — please read
This mod is free, and it should only ever be downloaded from Nexus Mods, uploaded by me.
No resale. You may not sell this mod, put it behind a paywall, or include it in any paid content, paid mod pack or paid access of any kind — with or without modification.
No re-uploading or redistribution. Do not repost, mirror, re-share or re-upload this mod to any other website, file host, forum, cloud drive or social platform without my written permission.
No bundling into personal mod packs. You may not pack this mod into your own mod pack / collection / all-in-one download and distribute that outside of Nexus Mods without my written permission.
Translations — very welcome, but please contact me first; with credit you may publish a translation.
Videos, streams and screenshots — allowed and encouraged, credit appreciated.

A word from the author
My English isn't very good — this page was written with a lot of help from translation tools, so please excuse any awkward wording. Thank you for liking this mod!
I'll keep updating it: Ridgeside Village (RSV) obelisks are next, followed by more mods aimed at players who enjoy female-oriented aesthetics. Feedback and suggestions are always welcome.
MniCal的美男方尖碑替换
把四座方尖碑换成美男贴图，并在传送时随机显示一句提示。
本模组会把原版的四座方尖碑（沙漠 / 大地 / 海岛 / 水流）替换为美化贴图，并在你使用方尖碑传送时，于屏幕左下角随机显示一句提示。所有功能都可以在游戏内的设置菜单里开关。

安装方法
先装好 SMAPI。
（可选） 安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，这样才有游戏内的设置菜单。
解压下载的压缩包，把 `MniCal's Handsome Obelisks` 文件夹放进游戏目录的 `Stardew Valley/Mods` 文件夹里。注意 `manifest.json` 必须直接在这个文件夹内。
启动游戏。

作者的话

感谢你的喜欢！ 接下来我会继续更新：RSV（里奇赛德村）的图腾（方尖碑），以及其他偏向女性玩家喜好的模组，敬请期待。有任何建议都欢迎在帖子区告诉我。
